title: I think I suck at my own game...
author: Parreirao2
selftext:
So this is a side project I've been making for a long time, a Pokemon Game for Android that started as a Virtual Pet from an esp32 and now it has so much content I don't even bother to try other official Pokémon games, at this point if I like something I see, I just make it myself on my game in my own way.

For instance, I've been making this Game Mode, which is inspired by the Big Kid Nation project, just for fun, as an alternative game mode to keep me entertained during work breaks.

If anyone's interested in it, I can definitely showcase more of the app, it has traditional battles, map with every generation regions and routes, PMD game mode, ports of games from old devices like the e-reader, contests, breeding, farms, prismatics (copied from Aniimo), TCG, etc etc...

comments.author: khodakk
comments.body:
lol everyone literally making the same game. realtime pokemon battles and pokemon survivors.

it does sound like you have a lot more game than just this tho. but also kinda sounds like its a mix of a bunch of games which could feel disjointed but no way to know without playing. 

anyways what you have looks good. the camera and effects even the mechanics. all standard but everything has enough polish that it looks like a fun game.

replies.author: SmartCustard9944
replies.body: Been like that since forever, even pre-AI. Pokémon is a beloved franchise and the most popular one, so it is not surprising.
